observations.location: Architecture and training / Looping design; Monitorability of looped transformers
observations.finding: The released model repeats its middle layers with fixed loop count. A separate variable-loop research model supports comparisons between loop counts.
The experiment prompts models with constraints on their reasoning text and reports poor ability to meet those constraints. It does not describe a live user interface for mid-generation intervention.
The retrieved article contains no matching text for interface, intervention, or during generation. This corroborates the substantive reading; word absence alone is not the decision basis.
